identification.summary: APT.3102 is a label for China-linked actors that Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 reported using a variant of the 9002 Trojan, which it named 3102, in May 2015 spear-phishing against a US government entity and a European media company [S1].
identification.notes: The name comes from the malware: the payload sends the string 3102 as the first four bytes of its C2 traffic [S1]. Unit 42 linked the payload to Evilgrab used in a May 2015 watering-hole attack on the Myanmar president's website, and noted a 2014 Cylance report on a 3102 variant used against a Chinese national [S1]. Not mapped to a MITRE group or Microsoft name in the record.

attribution.confidence: Unit 42 stated it found links between the C2 infrastructure and individuals in China active in hacking forums that advertise Trojan development [S1]. No state sponsor is stated in the material reviewed.
attribution.basis: C2 infrastructure links to individuals in China active in Trojan-development forums, per Unit 42 [S1].

targeting.notes: One US government entity and one European media company received the same lure document [S1]. The Myanmar presidential website was a related watering-hole case [S1].

capabilities.summary: Spear-phishing with a lure document that installed the 3102 payload, a 9002 variant that depends heavily on plugins for its capabilities [S1]. The sample lacks its own configuration and relies on a second payload that stores the configuration in the registry and then deletes itself, which complicates extraction of C2 details [S1].

campaigns.name: 3102 spear-phishing of US government and EU media
campaigns.summary: Unit 42 observed attacks on 6 and 11 May 2015 in which the same lure document was sent to a US government entity and a European media company [S1].

campaigns.name: Myanmar president website watering hole (related)
campaigns.summary: Unit 42 assessed the 3102 payload as related to the Evilgrab payload used in a May 2015 watering-hole attack on the Myanmar president's website [S1].

diamond.adversary: China-based individuals linked to Trojan-development forums via C2 infrastructure, per Unit 42 [S1].
diamond.capability: 9002 variant (3102) with plugins; second-stage payload storing configuration in the registry [S1].
diamond.infrastructure: C2 infrastructure tied by Unit 42 to individuals in China; specific indicators not reviewed [S1].
diamond.victim: US government entity and European media company [S1].

gaps: Only one search succeeded (search budget exhausted) and the Unit 42 report and Malpedia page could not be fetched; facts rely on a search-result summary of the Unit 42 report, not the full text.
Exploit or CVE used by the lure document, C2 domains, and IOCs not reviewed.
No state sponsor, tasking organization, or confidence level identified.
No post-2015 activity, MITRE group ID, or Microsoft naming identified.
Overlap with 9002/Evilgrab users and the 2014 Cylance report not resolved; do not merge clusters without primary documents.
